metadata.description: Official Ringee plugins for Claude Code — operate outbound calling, contacts, leads, call sessions, callbacks and meetings through the Ringee MCP.

plugins.name: ringee
plugins.description: Operate Ringee from Claude: search/create/update/delete contacts, prospect/reveal/import leads (Apollo/Prospeo), create/manage call sessions (magic links), log call outcomes, and schedule callbacks/meetings — all on top of the Ringee MCP, with safety rules for sensitive and destructive actions.
